title: Slider
description: Fiori Slider and RangeSlider: tickmarks with labels, tooltips, UI5 keyboard model (ui5-slider, ui5-range-slider).

usage.summary: Adjust one value or a numeric interval along a visual scale.
useWhen: Let users adjust settings such as volume or brightness without typing an exact number.
Use Slider for one value and RangeSlider for lower and upper bounds.
Show the current value, unit and scale bounds so the adjustment has a clear meaning.
Set min, max and step to the valid range and required precision; use showTooltip for handle values.

avoidWhen.when: Enter an exact quantity using explicit increment and decrement controls.
Enter a number without needing a visual scale.
Choose categorical answers rather than a numeric value.
Give an icon-based evaluation such as a star rating.
